POWER APPS & POWER AUTOMATE 
Railcar Safety and Compliance Management System – ChemCore Industries 
Role: Power Platform Developer | Duration: Jan 2025 – Sep 2025 
Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint and Azure-AD 
Project Overview: 
Developed a Power Apps Canvas app to manage safe loading and unloading of hazardous 
chemical railcars. Operators scan or enter a railcar number and complete digital checklists —pre-
operation, loading, and post-operation—with photo capture and supervisor signature. All data is 
stored in SharePoint, creating a full audit trail, and Power Automate sends instant alerts if any 
critical step fails. This paperless system improves safety, compliance, and real -time reporting for 
chemical railcar operations. 
 
Key Contributions: 
• Designed Canvas App forms for digital railcar safety checklists. 
• Integrated SharePoint for compliance and inspection data storage. 
• Implemented conditional validations to enforce safety protocols. 
• Configured Power Automate flows to send alerts on non-compliance. 
• Created audit logs with inspector details, timestamps, and approvals. 
• Enabled role-based access for inspectors, supervisors, and admins. 
 
Corporate Room Scheduling Application – GulfStar Energy Solutions 
Role: Power Platform Developer | Duration: May 2024 – Nov 2024 
Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, Dataverse and Azure-AD 
        Project Overview: 
Developed a Corporate Room scheduling application using Microsoft Power Apps. It allows 
employees to view available rooms, check details like capacity and equipment, and book rooms 
in real time. The app stores room and booking data in Dataverse and integrates with Office 365 
Outlook, so every confirmed booking automatically updates the shared calendar and prevents 
double-booking. I focused on a clean, mobile-friendly UI and built validations to block past dates 
and overlapping time slots. 
 
Key Contributions: 
• Design overall solution with Power Apps and Dataverse. 
• Use Dataverse to store Metadata about rooms and meeting information. 
• Integration with office365outlook so booking correspond to actual calendar entries. 
• Develop the flow to get room resources (email, names) and automatic updating room 
metadata into the Dataverse table. 
• UI/UX concerns like blocking past times, showing current date, ensuring valid times are 
• selectable, showing Today’s booking and upcoming bookings using Interactive gallery. 
• Implemented Role based Permissions (some can add rooms, others only book rooms). 
• Creating Security groups (using Azure -AD), Creating custom Security role and assigning 
this role to the security group (Dataverse Level). 
• Involved in Solution Deployment (Dev-UAT-production). 
 
Vehicle Tracking and Maintenance Application – GulfStar Energy Solutions 
Role: Power App Developer | Duration: Nov 2022 – Jun 2023 
Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, Dataverse and Azure-AD 
Project Overview: 
Developed a Power Apps Canvas App to manage a company’s entire vehicle fleet. It stores 
vehicle, driver, assignment, usage, and maintenance data in Dataverse, gives managers a 
dashboard screen to monitor data  and automate notifications and compliance checks with 
Power Automate. Drivers can log trips and fuel usage on mobile, while managers can assign 
vehicles and track maintenance in real time. 
 
Key Contributions: 
• Involved in Complete development of this Application. 
• Performed form-level customizations and managed enterprise-level solutions. 
• Built Power Apps forms and screens using Power Fx with collections & variables. 
• Dataverse for Data storage and security roles. 
• Power Automate flow sending reminder (compliance expiration date) and sending Email. 
• Azure-AD for Authentication and role-based access control. 
• Language and technology: Canvas App, Power Automate, Dataverse and Azure-AD. 
 
E-Voting and Poll Management Application – NBC Bearings (National Engineering 
Industries Ltd.) 
Role: Power App Developer | Duration: Jun 2022 – Sep 2022 
Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint and Office365 
 
 
Project Overview: 
I created an internal E -Voting system using Microsoft Power Apps Canvas App to run secure 
organizational elections like employee polls and award voting. Users log in with their Microsoft 
365 account, view ongoing elections, and can vote only once per election, with options for 
anonymity. Admins set up elections and candidates, while Power Automate sends reminders and 
vote confirmations. All votes and audit logs are stored in SharePoint, ensuring data security, 
transparency, and accurate results without paper or manual counting. 
 
Key Contributions: 
• Involved with complete development of this Project 
• SharePoint list as the Data source. 
• Login and role management using Microsoft365 identity. 
• Election setup and candidate management for admins. 
• Power Automate flow to send election announcements, Reminders and vote 
confirmations. 
 
Employee Onboarding and Access Request Management System – SinoCloud 
Technologies. 
Role: Power App Developer | Duration: Dec 2021 – May 2022 
Technologies: Canvas App, Power Automate, SharePoint and Office365 
Project Overview: 
Developed a Power Apps Canvas App with SharePoint as a backend to automate the Employee 
Onboarding and Access Request Management System . The app auto -fills user details, applies 
conditional rules based on hire type, validates contract dates, and on submission, stores data in 
SharePoint and sends confirmation emails via Power Automate. This reduced manual effort and 
streamlined onboarding for both employees and vendors. 
 
Key Contributions: 
• Requirement Gathering and Analysis. 
• Client Communication and End to End Delivery. 
• One of the key features was that if the logged -in user was raising a request for himself, 
his details got automatically populated using Office365 connector. 
• If the user was to submit on behalf of someone else, then he could select the username 
from dropdown most of the details would auto populate, while some fields like Name 
and Reporting manager remained editable. 
• There were also conditional rules. 
• Once the request was submitted, the data was saved into a SharePoint list, and a power 
automate flow was triggered to send confirmation Email to the requestor. 
• Solution Design and involve with the Team for every aspect of development.
